descripcion: NativOS is an experimental Linux-first Android GSI combining an Ubuntu/Phosh desktop with Android apps and hardware support. Features integrated Linux startup and APT package management. Boot-tested on Moto G71 and Pixel 6a; compatibility varies by device.

evidencia.nota: hash del JSON exacto devuelto por la API en la fecha declarada
